versions.changelog:
- Updated supported model: replaced "Suno V3" (`suno-v3`) and "Udio" (`udio`) with "Suno Music" (`suno_music`)
- Updated usage example to use the new model name "suno_music"
- No changes to overall functionality or instructions

Initial release – enables music generation via text or style prompts.

- Supports "Suno V3" and "Udio" music generation models.
- Run the skill only with the python command (not openclaw run).
- Usage requires the TEAM_API_KEY environment variable.
